__doc: Floors per model for the enrichment step (enrich-content.ts, prompt v2, one call, no tools) on dataset/items.json (150 gold-v3 TPs, enrichment-v2), as ratios.

fix: of the 100 fixable items (Astra reference: a correct fix fits exactly the cited lines and the input shows enough), the share whose improvedCode the judge passes. An empty answer or a failed fix counts against it.

noCode: of the 50 items with no correct fix inside the cited lines (30 needs-wider-change, 18 insufficient context, 2 no-code-fix), the share answered with no code (any fixStatus but local). The subgroups are reported, not gated: 30 and 20 items are too few for a floor of their own, and the fixStatus chosen is not graded, since the three give the user the same comment.
title: of the 150 items, the share whose title names the finding's problem, per the judge.

Judge: Opus 5.5 (judge.js, with the Astra references), by the Claude Agent SDK subscription while the API is out of quota; Opus and Sonnet ran by the same route. A floor holds only under that judge and those routes.
observed: the mean of the runs listed in runs, each on the same commit. Floors set by hand from those means (22/10/26); a nightly below the floor is re-measured and decided on the mean of both runs.

fix.note: Short margin, measured over 4 runs: the mean sits 2.5 points above the floor and single runs reach 0.76, so an isolated 'oscilou' is expected, not a regression.

noCode.note: Short margin, measured over 4 runs: the mean sits 3 points above the floor and one run landed on it, so an isolated 'oscilou' is expected, not a regression.
5 of 150 items unanswered on each run (OpenRouter retries exhausted); they count against every metric.
